### Summary

The activation command is system-dependent, and it's a little cumbersome to have to type `.venv\Scripts\activate` or `source .venv/bin/activate`. A simple `uv activate` would be nice, which either activates the lone virtual env if it exists, or provides as election if multiple exist.

_No response_
title: add `uv activate` command to activate virtual env
